summary: Loads Oculus Rift Touch controller geometry as SOP meshes for Windows VR controller visualization.
common_gotchas: This is a geometry loader, not the operator that provides tracking data or stereo rendering.
The operator is Windows-only, so cross-platform patches need a fallback mesh path.
Runtime availability still depends on Oculus runtime and hardware support outside the SOP itself.
key_concepts: Outputs controller model geometry rather than tracking channels or eye rendering.
The model menu chooses between the left and right Oculus Touch controller meshes.
The official page marks the operator as Microsoft Windows only.
